d:
Will mobile recharge prices rise again in India? Bharti Airtel Chairman Sunil Bharti Mittal, in a recent PTI interview, has argued that telecom tariffs need to increase, with the industry's average revenue per user (ARPU) moving towards ₹350 per month.
But why does Mittal want higher mobile tariffs when India already offers some of the cheapest mobile data in the world? Are Jio and Airtel preparing for another recharge price hike?
